auditor_value: |v| = sqrt(a(1 + p^2)/(2q)), directed at tan^-1(p) above the +x axis; components u_x = sqrt(a/(2q)), u_y = p*sqrt(a/(2q))
notes: Independent solve agrees on both magnitude and direction. Every line follows from the one above (t = x/u_x substituted into y, coefficients matched, 1/2 kept). The common-mistake number sqrt(a/q) is what dropping the 1/2 produces. Numerically checked with a = 10, p = 1, q = 0.1: u_x = u_y = 7.07, |u| = 10, and the trajectory reproduces y = px - qx^2.
